Container.Name: CrownJukebox
Container.Overview: CrownJukebox — Retro browser-based party jukebox. Point to your music folder and open on a TV/touchscreen. Also requires the crownjukebox/backend container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the jukebox web interface.

Config.Name: BACKEND_URL
Config.Description: URL to the CrownJukebox-Backend container. Use http://[unraid-ip]:8080 where 8080 matches the API Port set in the backend template.
